title: 咘咘会叫妈妈拉粑粑啦
title_en: Bubu Can Ask for the Potty Now!

pages.text: 咘咘会叫妈妈拉粑粑啦
pages.text_en: Bubu Can Ask for the Potty Now!

pages.text: 咘咘是一只越来越棒的小兔子。她已经学会了好多本领，其中最厉害的一个就是——想尿尿的时候，会大声叫妈妈！
pages.text_en: Bubu is a little bunny who keeps getting better every day. She has learned so many skills, and one of the best ones is — calling Mama when she needs to pee!

pages.text: “妈妈！尿尿！”每次咘咘一喊，Tina妈妈就会笑着牵她去卫生间。咘咘觉得自己特别了不起。
pages.text_en: "Mama! Pee pee!" Every time Bubu calls out, Mama Tina smiles and takes her to the bathroom. Bubu feels so proud of herself.

pages.text: 可是呢，有一件事情咘咘还没学会。每次肚子咕噜咕噜想便便的时候，咘咘总是忘记叫妈妈。
pages.text_en: But there's one thing Bubu hasn't quite figured out yet. Every time her tummy rumbles and she needs to poop, she always forgets to call Mama.

pages.text: 有时候便便就偷偷跑进了裤子里。Tina妈妈一边帮咘咘换裤子，一边温柔地说：“没关系，下次记得叫妈妈哦。”
pages.text_en: Sometimes the poop sneaks right into her pants. Mama Tina gently changes her clothes and says, "It's okay, just remember to call Mama next time."

pages.text: NOMI摸摸咘咘的头说：“别着急，慢慢来，你一定可以的。”NONO在旁边拍着翅膀给咘咘加油。
pages.text_en: NOMI pats Bubu's head and says, "Don't worry, take your time. You can do it!" NONO flaps his wings to cheer her on.

pages.text: 今天下午，咘咘正在客厅里和NOMI一起搭积木。突然，她的小肚子咕噜噜地响了起来。
pages.text_en: This afternoon, Bubu is building blocks with NOMI in the living room. Suddenly, her little tummy starts rumbling.

pages.text: 咘咘愣了一下，摸了摸自己的肚子。她想起了妈妈的话——“记得叫妈妈哦。”
pages.text_en: Bubu pauses and touches her tummy. She remembers what Mama said — "Remember to call Mama."

pages.text: “妈妈！便便！”咘咘大声喊了出来。这是她第一次主动叫妈妈要便便！Tina妈妈从厨房跑过来，惊喜极了。
pages.text_en: "Mama! Poop!" Bubu shouts out loud. This is the first time she asks for help on her own! Mama Tina rushes from the kitchen, absolutely thrilled.

pages.text: 妈妈牵着咘咘的小手来到卫生间，帮她坐上小马桶。咘咘稳稳地坐好，小脚丫轻轻晃着。
pages.text_en: Mama takes Bubu's little hand and leads her to the bathroom, helping her sit on the potty. Bubu sits steadily, her little feet dangling gently.

pages.text: “嗯——”咘咘努力了一小会儿。成功啦！她拉了一坨大大的便便！咘咘开心地拍着小手说：“便便出来啦！”
pages.text_en: "Mmm—" Bubu tries for a little moment. Success! She did a big poop! Bubu claps her hands happily and says, "The poop came out!"

pages.text: NOMI和NONO冲进来为咘咘鼓掌。“太棒了咘咘！”NONO兴奋地在空中转了一个圈。妈妈笑着说：“咘咘真厉害，以后不用穿尿片啦！”
pages.text_en: NOMI and NONO rush in to applaud. "Amazing, Bubu!" NONO excitedly loops in the air. Mama smiles and says, "Bubu is so amazing, no more diapers from now on!"

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘穿着干干净净的小内裤，骄傲地走来走去。她是一个越来越棒的小朋友啦！晚安，了不起的咘咘。
pages.text_en: That evening, Bubu walks around proudly in her clean little underpants. She's getting better and better every day! Good night, amazing Bubu.
